resources.string: LoveBrain message capture service. When capture is on, it listens for long-press and window events in the chat apps you allow and reads the related node text to identify the message you long-pressed that shows a \"Copy\" menu. Captured text goes into the LoveBrain overlay; when you ask the AI for a reply it is sent to the model provider you configured; when you finish and save a round, some of it may be written to the local knowledge base. The service never taps or sends messages for you. You can turn capture off or revoke the accessibility permission at any time.
